use_when: On every back office page, fixed on the left at full height, with header type=backoffice to its right.
Mark the page you are on as active, and only that one: the app currently always marks Dashboard active, which needs fixing.
Keep the item order the same on every page, so people find things by position.
Use short labels of one to three words, such as "Team and roles".
Show which organisation and how many properties the admin is looking at in the footer.
Hide items the person's role can't open, instead of showing them disabled.

dont_use_when.when: On the guest website or app: use header type=web or type=app instead.
For actions such as "Export" or "Add rate": put them in the page, under the title.
For more than 12 items: group them, or move rare ones into Settings.

placement: On the left of a back office page, with header type=backoffice to its right (the BackOfficePage story).

a11y.fact: The items sit in a native <nav> landmark, named by navLabel (default "Main").
The items are a list (<ul>, <li>), so a screen reader announces how many there are.
Each item is Horizon's Link, a native <a href>, so Tab, Shift+Tab and Enter work with no extra script.
The current page is marked aria-current="page", not by colour alone.
The logo mark is decorative (empty alt), since the title beside it names the app.
The footer divider is hidden from assistive technology.
A keyboard focus ring (color/border/focus, 2px) is drawn inside the item row.
